description: Variation of condition 2 (Approved drawings/and or documents) to allow: Enlargement of first floor element of two storey side extensionPitched roof to ground floor element of two storey side extensionWidening of existing side dormerRelocation of cycle storage to front gardenRelocation of air source heating pump of Householder reference 22/2735 dated 13 January, 2023, for Demolition of existing detached garage and erection of single storey rear extension, part single storey part two storey side to rear extension, side to rear dormer window roof extension with rear balcony. External wall insulation and render to the existing property. Associated front and rear hardscaping and soft landscaping, refuse store, air source heat pump store to front garden and a raised rear patio to dwellinghouse.
